g.text: SMARTBOW AI — 1:1 CALIBRATED ARUCO FIDUCIAL PRINT SHEET
OPENCV DICT_4X4_50 SPECIFICATION · PRECISION PROSTHODONTIC RESEARCH SPEC
MANDATORY: PRINT AT 100% SCALE (ACTUAL SIZE) · DO NOT FIT TO PAGE
PHYSICAL 100.0 mm SCALE BAR — VERIFY WITH VERNIER CALIPER BEFORE CUTTING
PASS TOLERANCE: 100.0 ± 0.2 mm · If reading differs, disable printer driver auto-scaling
1. OCCLUSAL RIM BUCCAL TARGET ARRAYS (18.0 × 18.0 × 3.0 mm)
Affix onto right buccal premolar surface with sticky wax & 0.8mm SS tag wire. Clearance: ≥5.0mm from occlusal table.
• Quiet Zone Margin: 2.0 mm (≥1.5 mm req)
• Occlusal Clearance: ≥5.0 mm | Plate Gap: ≥2.0 mm
2. FACIAL & HANAU ARTICULATOR REFERENCE MARKERS (14.0 × 14.0 mm)
Establish cranial reference plane (F01–F03) & mechanical articulator condylar axis registration (H01–H02).
3. CAMERA INTRINSICS CALIBRATION TARGET (60.0 × 60.0 mm RIGID CARD)
3×3 ArUco array for pinhole focal length (fx, fy), optical center (cx, cy), & Brown-Conrady lens distortion (k1, k2).
IDs 20–28 · Clean DICT_4X4_50 · Mount on rigid substrate
Affix 60×60 mm card onto rigid acrylic plate (surface flatness ≤ 0.05 mm).
Hold at 45–50 cm under uniform, non-glare, diffuse illumination.
Capture 10 non-coplanar tilt poses (pitch / yaw / roll between 15° and 35°).
All 9 fiducials (IDs 20–28) must be simultaneously detected in every frame.
Reprojection RMS error must strictly satisfy: RMS < 0.50 px root-mean-square.
• Gate blocks clinical VDO metric logging until camera intrinsics pass.
• Stale optical telemetry (>500 ms) yields MEASUREMENT_NOT_AVAILABLE.
• Uncalibrated lenses induce barrel/pincushion optical error up to ±2.8 mm.
STATUS: Optical diagnostics gate active · OpenCV DICT_4X4_50
Maitri College of Dentistry & Research Centre · Dept. of Prosthodontics · Dr. Deepanshu
SmartBow AI Research Specification v1.2 · Grounded in Boucher (12th ed., Ch. 14, pp. 248–251) & Winkler (2nd ed., Ch. 12, pp. 195–198)
Fiducial Dictionary: DICT_4X4_50 · Scale Factor: 1.0000 (1:1 Physical Scale) · Independently verified against OpenCV Ground Truth
